summary: English and Indonesian first-party discovery identified the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Metro and the official BHUMI ATR/BPN map. The live BHUMI catalog exposed the Bidang Tanah / umum:Persil configuration and safe display fields, but direct anonymous WMS/WFS capability routes returned the site's 404 HTML and the current client shows token-gated parcel retrieval. No parcel geometry or native identity was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, configuration inspection, direct requests, response outcomes, field allowlist, and scope limits are recorded in city-5461-metro.json. No browser login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, or unsafe-field request occurred.
